## Security checklist

- [ ] No secret, password, token, private key or real IP/hostname in the diff
- [ ] New secrets come from `.env` (gitignored), Ansible Vault or GitHub Actions secrets
- [ ] Only synthetic data: no production or customer data, logs or exports
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally
